contentPattern.structure: heading column + arrow-led navigation link-list column

suitableFor: mid/bottom-of-page 'learn more' or 'explore more' link bands
a section heading beside a stacked list of arrow-led related-page links
notSuitableFor: sticky top-of-page in-page anchor navigation (use columns-nav)
media + text feature rows (use columns-feature / columns-accent)
